_why: The <title> and meta description for every page build_site.js writes itself. One file so Search Readiness b1 (title 30-65, unique) and b2 (description 120-160) are checked in one place; scripts/validate_head_and_schema.js enforces both against the built pages, and the build stops on a route that is missing here. Resource and question pages carry their own: resources from seoTitle/seoDescription in their frontmatter, question pages from the shared search loop.

/.title: Dr. Cynthia Brown, DDS | Olive Branch and Southaven Dentist
/.description: Dr. Cynthia Brown, DDS is a dentist and practice owner seeing patients in Olive Branch and Southaven, Mississippi. Clear dental education, no pressure.

about.title: About Dr. Cynthia Brown, DDS | Olive Branch Dentist
about.description: A Memphis native, Spelman graduate and Meharry-trained dentist. Dr. Brown on her background, her approach in the chair, and what a visit is like.

locations.title: Locations | Dr. Cynthia Brown, DDS
locations.description: Dr. Cynthia Brown, DDS sees patients in Olive Branch and Southaven, Mississippi. Choose a location and continue to the current scheduling page to book.

services.title: Services | Dr. Cynthia Brown, DDS
services.description: An educational overview of preventive, restorative and cosmetic dental care, emergencies, dentures, implants and whitening questions, in plain language.

smile-philosophy.title: Smile Philosophy | Dr. Cynthia Brown, DDS
smile-philosophy.description: Confidence is not only appearance. How Dr. Brown thinks about health, comfort and clarity together, and why informed patients make calmer decisions.

resources.title: Resources | Dr. Cynthia Brown, DDS
